gtetscore.machine.et_tag_filter.share.ti: Whether other multiblocks may occupy this part
Off (isolated): if this part already belongs to a formed multiblock, another structure's check fails here. Prevents recipe mixups.
On (allowed): another structure must be re-formed (checked again) to take this part; already formed structures do not change by themselves.
Toggling re-checks this part's own multiblocks at once; the change takes effect on structure re-check.

gtetscore.wireless_energy_hatch.panel.wr: Not supplying: the master tower is in another dimension (cross-dimension needs a link tower, not implemented yet)
Converts time flow from the master tower into EU. Base loss is 8% at IV, dropping linearly to 2% at MAX; the first 128 blocks (8 chunks) are loss-free, then up to +15% more by 4096 blocks. Right-click with a time clock bound to a master tower to bind this hatch. Cross-dimension supply is not implemented yet (needs a link tower), so another dimension never supplies EU.

item.gtetscore.advanced_terminal.setting: Set the priority level for automatic coil placement.
Number of repetitions of the structure
Used to set the number of repetitions for the placement of repeating parts in structures like distillation towers, assembly lines, etc.
Whether to enable the no-Hatch mode. When enabled the machine is built with no hatches at all: every hatch position is filled with the matching machine casing instead.
Whether to enable the coil-replace mode. After enabling the coil-replace mode, coil will be replaced by the Coil before.
Whether to enable to use items in AE. After enabling this, you can autobuild with items in AE storage by an ME terminal.
AE network link is not ported yet - this option does nothing.
Whether to enable the mirror build. After enabling this, the structure is placed mirrored (flipped left/right or front/back).
Which structure to build: 0 = main structure, N = the N-th structure. If the controller only has the main structure, the main structure is built.
Modular machines are not ported yet - this option does nothing for now.

Whether to enable the demolition mode. After enabling this, blocks are no longer placed: the structure blocks at each position are removed instead. Blocks that do not belong to this structure are left untouched.
